description: Self-Renovate policy for the shared Gradle build-logic repository. Consumers inherit the shared policy from the root default.json (gitlab>magisk3171/shared/magisk-ci-toolkit preset); this file only overrides what differs for this repository. Without it the shared Renovate template fails closed: it sets requireConfig=required with onboarding=false and looks for .gitlab/renovate.json before falling back to renovate.json.

packageRules.description: The gradle-wrapper manager refreshes distributionSha256Sum by running the wrapper task in the project that owns the file. shared/gradle/wrapper is a staged bundle -- there is no settings file and no build there -- so the task cannot run and Renovate falls back to rewriting distributionUrl alone, which is how 9.9.0-rc-1 landed with the 9.9.0-milestone-2 checksum. Nothing in the fleet builds this directory, so the mismatch would stay invisible until the next consumer sync. The wrapper pair is therefore moved on purpose: bump a consumer (where the task really runs and the build verifies the result), then install the approved copy here; scripts/check_wrapper_checksums.sh guards the invariant.
